name: @digitalforgestudios/openclaw-sulcus
description: Sulcus — thermodynamic memory + Apache AGE knowledge graph for OpenClaw agents. v5.8: SIRU (Recall Unit) live — adaptive scoring weights learned from recall sessions, server-side training via /api/v2/siu/retrain?model=siru, recall session logging, recall feedback. Multi-signal recall (semantic + hot-context + entity-graph + profile), token budget enforcement, composite scoring with SIRU-adaptive weights. SIU v2 pipeline (SIVU/SICU/SILU/SIRU). before_prompt_build hook. Interaction-based decay. Curator sleep-cycle.
